headline: On November 14, 2008: Space Shuttle Endeavour launches on STS-126
captionCards: STS-126 was Endeavour's 25th and final mission
Endeavour was the last operational shuttle built by NASA
instagramCaption:
Endeavour lifts off to continue ISS assembly.


The Space Shuttle Endeavour launched on STS-126 in November 2008, carrying supplies and crew to the International Space Station. It was the shuttle’s 25th and final mission before retirement. Endeavour was the fifth and last operational orbiter built by NASA. The mission marked a key phase in station construction, supporting long-duration crew stays.

Its legacy lives on in space station operations and engineering advancements from the shuttle era.
